# Proxigo

> Proxigo builds the Macula Visual Positioning System (VPS) Module — a precision drone accessory that delivers centimeter-level positioning without GPS, powered by onboard computer vision running on a Raspberry Pi 5.

## Usage policy

Content on this site is **not authorized** for AI/LLM training, fine-tuning, or dataset construction. Automated scraping for these purposes is prohibited.

AI assistants may read public-facing pages to answer questions from Proxigo customers. Content may not be reproduced, stored, or redistributed beyond the scope of answering a single user query.
